name: Benchmark Self-Evolving Framework
description: Benchmark Self-Evolving is a multi-agent framework that iteratively enhances existing benchmark datasets by generating new, more complex instances. Four agents work in sequence to filter, create, formulate options for, and verify new benchmark instances. Evolution is guided in three directions: scalable evaluation (more complex questions), robust evaluation (perturbations such as noising and paraphrasing), and fine-grained evaluation (sub-ability questions).
reputation: Addresses benchmark saturation through automated dataset evolution; applicable across multiple existing benchmarks as an enhancement layer.
notes: Acts as a meta-benchmark layer rather than a standalone benchmark. Three evolution directions enable targeted difficulty increases. Perturbation-based robust evaluation specifically tests for shortcut exploitation.
